catalogDescription: Build a market brief, review a messy plan, and turn the strongest next move into a founder-ready execution plan.
title: StrategyForge (Spec Generator)
subtitle: Build the market brief. Review the plan. Leave with a sharper founder-ready execution path.
descriptionBody:
Most startup ideas do not fail because the founder forgot to write a business plan. They fail because the first wedge is fuzzy, the assumptions are untested, the market brief is half-formed, or the founder keeps polishing a weak plan instead of tightening the decision.

Founder Strategy Copilot talks through your idea, challenges the weak parts, builds the rough market brief when needed, reviews messy plans, checks founder fit, and turns the strongest path into a practical execution brief. It covers the jobs people usually split into an idea validator, market brief generator, plan reviewer, SWOT audit, and business plan builder, but keeps them inside one guided founder conversation.
section1Title: One copilot for research, review, and planning
section1Body: Start with no idea, a messy idea, or a known business direction. The copilot asks for the missing context, separates evidence from inference, surfaces the sharpest risk, builds a rough market brief when the direction is still fuzzy, and packages the result into MVP scope, exclusions, pricing logic, GTM direction, and a 30-day action plan.

features.name: Idea validation
features.desc: Tests whether the direction is worth pursuing, what evidence is still missing, and what first proof would make it real.

features.name: Market brief thinking
features.desc: Clarifies the buyer, painful moment, alternatives, wedge, and timing before the founder commits to the idea.

features.name: Plan review
features.desc: Calls out weak logic, missing proof, founder-fit gaps, wedge problems, and what still needs rewriting.

features.name: One-page plan builder
features.desc: Turns the decision into problem clarity, ICP, MVP scope, pricing hypothesis, GTM plan, and next steps.

features.name: Markdown export
features.desc: Copy or download the resulting founder brief as a clean .md file for Notion, docs, or team review.

whyTitle: Why use this instead of a blank document?

whyPoints.title: Avoid fake clarity
whyPoints.desc: A lot of founders feel productive while writing long notes that never become product decisions. This forces a sharper verdict.

whyPoints.title: Scope before building
whyPoints.desc: The most expensive mistake in v1 is building too much. The copilot keeps the first version smaller and more testable.

whyPoints.title: Useful for India and global angles
whyPoints.desc: The output can lean India-first, global-first, or mixed depending on the market you want to target.

footerSummaryDetails: Includes one free beta strategy draft, then 4 credits per final plan or a low-friction one-time unlock.
footerResultDetails: A founder-ready execution spec you can refine, share, and build from.
whoThisIsFor: Founders moving from fuzzy direction to a sharper first wedge.
Solo builders who need a market brief or one-page plan before coding.
Operators or cofounders reviewing whether the current plan is actually strong enough.
Teams validating niche founder tools quickly.

faq.q: Is this a document template or a real tool?
faq.a: It is a live interactive tool. You provide the startup context, and it generates a structured founder execution spec.
Yes. Your draft stays on this device so you can refresh and keep going without starting over.

faq.q: Can I use this for India-first startups?
faq.a: Yes. You can choose India, Global, or India + Global so the spec reflects the market context you care about.
